# Favorit SPA

> Favorit SPA (Favorit DOO) is a small European manufacturer of hot tubs (spa, jacuzzi, massage pools) from Šabac, Serbia. For 30 years the company has designed, built, sold and serviced its own tubs: seven models in three lines, for 2 to 6 people, with Gecko control systems, spare parts in stock and a 24-month warranty. The website is available in English, Serbian, Croatian, Bosnian, Montenegrin, Slovenian, Hungarian, German, Albanian, Swedish and Greek.

- Company: Favorit DOO, Borivoja Jevtića bb, 15000 Šabac, Serbia. Showroom and production open Monday to Saturday.
- Contact: sales@favoritspa.com, +381 62 800 12 12 (Serbia), +382 68 37 10 10 (Montenegro), +387 65 200 105 (Bosnia and Herzegovina), +385 91 924 77 27 (Croatia).
- Popular on the Adriatic coast and in mountain ski resorts; owners from Sweden to Greece.

## Models

- [Zen](https://www.favoritspa.com/en/hot-tubs/zen/): Effect line, 5 people, 2180 x 2180 mm, up to 55 jets, from EUR 6500. Five seats, a lounger and room for everyone to find their place. Zen is the tub where evenings stretch on by themselves.
- [Eden](https://www.favoritspa.com/en/hot-tubs/eden/): Effect line, 6 people, diameter 2140 mm, up to 50 jets, from EUR 7600. Six seats in a circle, face to face. Eden is made for family, friends and long conversations under the stars.
- [Pearl](https://www.favoritspa.com/en/hot-tubs/pearl/): Effect line, 3 people, 2180 x 1600 mm, up to 41 jets, from EUR 5400. Made for two, with room for a guest. A lounger, a quiet massage and the same horizon.
- [Garden](https://www.favoritspa.com/en/hot-tubs/garden/): Effect line, 6 people, 2130 x 2130 mm, up to 74 jets, from EUR 7900. The largest in the range: six seats, strong pumps and a full-body massage. Garden turns a backyard into a private spa.
- [Fusion](https://www.favoritspa.com/en/hot-tubs/fusion/): Midl line, 4 people, 1980 x 1980 mm, up to 28 jets, from EUR 4280. Two loungers and two seats in a compact square. Everything you need, nothing you don’t.
- [Melody](https://www.favoritspa.com/en/hot-tubs/melody/): Midl line, 2 people, 1600 x 1500 mm, up to 26 jets, from EUR 5000. For two, for small terraces and big moments. Melody fits where other tubs can’t.
- [Point](https://www.favoritspa.com/en/hot-tubs/point/): Entry line, 4 people, 1600 x 1500 mm, up to 10 jets, from EUR 4090. The shortest way to a spa of your own. Four seats, simple to run, and an easy first step.

## Key facts

- No plumbing needed: a level concrete base and a 3x2.5 mm2 or 5x2.5 mm2 power cable; filled with a garden hose, drained through a built-in valve.
- Running cost: on average about EUR 20 a month for energy and filters.
- Service life: 15 to 20 years with regular care.
- Warranty: 24 months for private use, 12 months for commercial use, all built-in components.
- Spare parts ordered by noon on a working day ship for next-day delivery; phone and video technical support.
